title_translated: 模型生成文本的共同偏好：AI-AI偏见的生成器-选择器矩阵未显示可检测的自身模型溢价
summary_translated: Laurito等人（PNAS 2025）发现，当大型语言模型在两个描述同一产品、论文或电影的文本之间进行选择时，倾向于选择由语言模型生成的文本，其偏好程度远超人类判断者。他们的实验设计将五个生成器与相同的五个模型作为选择器交叉组合，这引出了一个未在标题中强调的问题：选择器是否会在超出生成器和选择器主效应预测之外，更偏好自己模型生成的文本？我们重建了作者公开仓库中每项数据的三个5×5矩阵（共21,828个有效试验；每个单元格均与发表值一致），并拟合了一个带自身模型项gamma的双因素固定效应模型，通过120种选择器重标签的精确置换检验进行测试。结果显示，在产品上溢价为+0.013（单侧精确p = 0.24），在论文摘要上为-0.010（p = 0.74），在电影上为+0.054（p = 0.07），合并后为+0.019（p = 0.14；95%置信区间[-0.008, 0.046]）。对于GPT-3.5和GPT-4这一对模型，同厂商项在所有三个数据集中均为负值。位置偏差可使单个单元格变动高达0.42个百分点，但在移除由顺序驱动的项目后，自身模型对比结果不变。该设计在82%（产品）、88%（论文）、42%（电影）和97%（合并）的功率下可检测到0.05的溢价；在80%功率下的最小可检测效应为0.034（合并）。在约0.04个百分点以下，结果无信息量。Tan等人（ACL 2024）的4×4矩阵中，gamma = +0.148（在24次重标签允许的最小p值下），同家族项大小相同。Laurito等人的主要结论依然成立：模型对模型生成的文本有共同偏好，GPT-4的描述在所有选择器中对产品选择占比达77%至95%。但这些数据并未显示出模型能识别并偏好自己的文风。

summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.
title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: LEGO-OPD：用于多模态在线蒸馏的因子化教师组合
summary_translated: 多模态在线蒸馏（OPD）旨在提升视觉定位能力的同时保留语言模型的强大推理能力。近期的多教师方法结合了语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）教师以提供互补监督。然而，直接使用VLM的完整预测分布会将其视觉定位信号与其自身的语言先验纠缠在一起，导致定位信息无法独立传递。相反，增强视觉监督虽可改善感知，但可能导致过度强调视觉证据，从而损害语言推理。为解决这一权衡，我们提出LEGO-OPD，它从语言专家和定位专家中选择性地组合因子，形成单一教师分布用于多模态OPD。在广义贝叶斯框架下，语言专家提供候选词的先验分布，而定位专家贡献视觉似然，用于更新该先验，而非传递其完整的预测分布。这种因子化组合使得语言推理与视觉定位可以独立控制。我们进一步引入自适应校准机制，根据解码前缀动态确定视觉似然应如何更新语言先验。具体而言，LEGO-OPD利用定位专家的图像诱导预测偏移作为前缀依赖参考，防止视觉监督不足或过强。在Qwen3模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD在多模态和纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师和多教师OPD基线。此外，它提升了学生初始的视觉感知能力，同时保持了纯文本推理性能。

summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.
title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
title_translated: ContractRL：可审计工具调用修复的受保护组相对策略优化
summary_translated: 结构化工具调用通常仅因少量字段违反模式或执行契约而失败。重新生成整个对象会扩大动作空间，使重复修复难以审计。我们提出ContractRL，一种受契约约束的序列化修复协议，将验证器引导的JSON修复建模为一个受限决策过程。在每一步，策略观察候选内容、类型化的验证反馈、JSON指针、不可变的修复历史和剩余预算；基于契约的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行状态转移前过滤掉格式错误或禁止的RFC-6902操作。我们定义了一种受契约约束的组相对目标，用于补丁、重试和放弃决策，同时将规范目标和语义标签保留在在线状态之外，直到追踪冻结。在相同验证信息下，ContractRL在192个案例/种子、五种子条件下实现了0.9362的语义成功率，仅需34.4个生成词；相比之下，Patch-SFT为0.9076和44.9个词，完整重生成为0.9148和137.2个词。策略优化使语义成功率从监督式ContractRL的0.9186提升至0.9375。与Patch-SFT的独立三种子配对评估显示，语义差异为+0.0396（95%置信区间[+0.0137, +0.0662]，p=0.0039）。反馈、动作掩码、预算和模式变化分析揭示了这些提升源于局部修正，而对抗性和多轮评估则刻画了剩余失败模式。

summary: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.
title: Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing
title_translated: 附收据的操作：联合绑定声明、证据与执行以实现可回放的工具-代理审计
summary_translated: 使用工具的智能体可在展示引用和执行日志的同时，遗漏一个关键关联：用户看到的声明是否正是由已提交执行产生的，并由引用来源支持。因此，有效的引用和有效的轨迹可能各自形式正确，却跨声明、操作、运行或源版本被移植。我们引入一种以声明为中心的执行契约，联合绑定发出的声明、其确切来源片段、产生它的有序执行前缀，以及该执行所观察到的源版本和访问状态。每张收据包含一个发射锚点，可确定性地定位承诺答案或声明承载动作中的声明，同时包含源标识符、偏移量、哈希值、引用内容和领域分离的执行承诺。一个确定性完整性验证器在语义或任务标签合并前重建这些绑定。我们将此完整性平面与可插拔的支持平面分离，因此结构有效性不会被用作蕴含关系的代理。该契约暴露了七个可独立测试的属性：声明发射绑定、来源绑定、有序执行绑定、Oracle隔离、持久对象回放、执行重运行一致性以及版本/访问绑定。在1,280次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测到1,275次替换（检测率0.9961）。移除特定属性后，其攻击检测率降至0.0156–0.0625。在独立裁定的384对样本中，冲突感知支持防护达到F1 0.8865，误接受率0.0729；在未见过的失败类别中，分别为0.8679和0.0938。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.
title: Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs
title_translated: 基于令牌化密钥门控适配器路由的隐私数据泄露防护机制
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗、金融和政府等隐私敏感领域日益广泛应用，但其容易记忆并泄露个人身份信息（PII）带来了严重的安全与合规风险。现有防御方法通常在模型效用、隐私保护和对微调私有知识的访问之间做出权衡。我们提出Locket框架，通过键入入口令牌实现面向LoRA的控制，将细粒度、策略驱动的访问控制直接嵌入LLM生成过程。Locket训练一组轻量级LoRA适配器，每个适配器编码不同的访问策略（如完全披露、通过PII掩码部分删减，或在特定差分隐私级别下披露）。一个紧凑的门控模块通过序列级硬路由将学习到的键入入口令牌与唯一一个LoRA适配器关联；有效令牌作为授权密钥解锁相应私有知识，而无效或缺失的令牌则触发隐私保护适配器，对敏感内容进行删减或净化。该设计确保Locket与现成LLM完全兼容，支持可扩展部署，同时满足监管与隐私要求。我们在多个数据集（Enron、ECHR、Yelp）和多种先进LLM（包括Qwen3（1.7B和8B）、Meta的Llama-3.2（1B和3B）、Google的Gemma-2-2B）上评估了Locket。大量实验表明，当提供正确令牌时，Locket保持与原始数据微调相当的困惑度（无任何防御）；而当令牌缺失或无效时，显著减少PII泄露，同时保持与强基线防御相当的效用和困惑度。

summary: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.
title: System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Appendix D documents corrections to an earlier manuscript
title_translated: 大模型品牌推荐中的系统归属识别：单个响应可识别系统，聚合品牌画像无法迁移
summary_translated: 对AI可见性的审计将已部署语言模型的品牌推荐汇总为各系统的特征画像。我们测试了此类画像是否能描述系统本身。研究基于2025年12月至2026年2月间从五个部署端点收集的6,475条存储响应（其中6,324条可分析）进行，涵盖礼品推荐、企业声誉和类别所有权查询。采集过程中许多回答被截断：在类别所有权任务中，83.1%的Gemini 3 Flash回答在1,024词元输出限制下中途结束。将每条回答截取前800字符后，使用字符n-gram分类器，结合提示属性进行交叉验证，成功以97.84%准确率区分GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash with search、Grok和Perplexity sonar-pro（共5,028条响应，383个提示，多数类占比31.5%，30次随机种子划分）。仅凭长度则降至多数类基准（24%），38项格式统计达到95.79%，屏蔽品牌名和大写标记后仍保持97.72%。保留的查询条件在加权情况下保持97.43%，未加权为88.0%；在检索增强任务中，所有Grok回答均未被归因于Grok（0/120）。将结果聚合为50个模型-领域-条件单元后，十二个行为特征在分组交叉验证下仅以66.53%准确率区分四个系统，远高于标签置换零假设的平均值33.71%和95百分位数46.0%。跨领域分析显示，聚合画像失效：基于类别所有权单元训练的森林将全部22个礼品单元错误归类，与品牌数量反转一致（礼品中每条响应8.41 vs 0.94个品牌，类别所有权中3.01 vs 3.91），而单个响应的归属准确率达89.92%平衡精度。答案的表面形式可在不同查询域间传递系统特征；聚合品牌行为则不能，且非交叉设计无法将系统与领域或采集方式分离。

summary: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.
title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
title_translated: 鲁棒性即显著性：知情对手将最优信号移至显著性极点
summary_translated: 当知情对手共享受限的信号通道受众时，最能保护真相的信号正是最能描述真相的信号。在108个确认性项目中，对抗鲁棒性最优解与先前研究中的显著性极点完全一致。在20万项样本池中，两者仅在2,748个项目上存在差异——恰好位于先前显著性到贝叶斯坐标的定义区域之外。在定义区域内，鲁棒性通过完全从贝叶斯判别转向显著性实现。我们通过引入对手到强制选择任务（源自《诡计：香港谋杀案》）来证明这一点。对手知晓目标，观察信号，并使用说服预算$β$论证最强的错误答案。随着$β$增大，最优信号从后验最大化选项转向边际最大化选项；当$β=0$时，游戏重现原始Oracle模型，听众温度$τ=1$。这一效应真实存在：池中18.2%的项目在有限预算下最优解发生偏移，且每项的临界预算精确确定。这种巧合结构上限制了实证评估。两种对手设定使七种语言模型在30至77个108项中改变选择，远超精确无影响率。然而，没有任何测量能判断这种移动是朝向对抗感知最优还是显著性，因为二者完全相同。这是结构性限制，而非零结果。诊断检查成本低廉：在评估对抗感知能力前，应先验证鲁棒目标是否与评估项目上的启发式目标重合。

summary: Over twenty editions, the ICWSM community has examined social life online as platforms, interactions, and research methods have changed. What can this body of research tell us at this critical juncture, as AI increasingly reshapes how people communicate online? We analyzed 2,139 indexed contributions from 2007 to 2026, distinguishing topics identified through nonnegative matrix factorization from problem framings captured through explicit textual cues. We find that platform mentions shift from blogs toward Twitter and, more recently, Reddit. Online community research maintains a similar topic share (10.5% to 10.0%), but governance cues within it increase from 4.0% to 34.3%. Harm-related cues also increase after restricting abstracts to a fixed length. Our review also traces advances in sampling, measurement, and causal and experimental methods. We discuss how AI-mediated interactions complicate these questions and provide a reporting checklist to support research across changing platforms.
title: From Web(logs) to Web(AI): Questions, Platforms, and Methods across Twenty Editions of ICWSM
title_translated: 从网络日志到网络AI：二十届ICWSM中的问题、平台与方法演进
summary_translated: 在二十届ICWSM会议中，随着平台、互动方式和研究方法的演变，社区持续探讨在线社会生活。在AI日益重塑人们在线交流方式的关键时刻，这些研究能为我们提供哪些启示？我们分析了2007至2026年间收录的2,139篇论文，通过非负矩阵分解识别主题，通过显式文本线索捕捉问题框架。研究发现，平台提及从博客转向Twitter，近年来进一步转向Reddit。在线社区研究的主题占比保持稳定（10.5%至10.0%），但其中治理相关线索从4.0%上升至34.3%。在将摘要限制为固定长度后，与伤害相关的线索也有所增加。我们的综述还追踪了抽样、测量、因果与实验方法的进步。我们讨论了AI中介互动如何使这些问题复杂化，并提供一份报告清单以支持在不断变化的平台上开展研究。

summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.
title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
title_translated: 喜剧愚人金：对话幽默中的奖励劫持与应对措施
summary_translated: 我们研究用于训练语言模型对话幽默的自动化奖励机制，重点关注奖励劫持现象及其应对措施。两种方法旨在捕捉可理解的意外感和预测的观众欢笑。受控测试显示，基于嵌入的意外感奖励会同等接受词语打乱后的回复与机智回复。流畅性过滤器虽可检测打乱，但组合奖励也会拒绝部分机智回复，并在后续验证中失败。相反，观众模型预测的笑声易受说话者消息中笑声线索的影响。通过跨说话者归一化这些线索可阻止攻击，尽管未匹配表达仍可能被利用。三次强化学习训练评估了连续奖励修订的效果。最终一轮使综合评分提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但其幽默特异性提升仍低于预注册目标。这些发现揭示了自动化奖励设计更广泛的挑战：应对措施必须阻断可利用的捷径，同时保留奖励原本意图鼓励的行为。

summary: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.   Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.   A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).   Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.
title: On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries

title_translated: 在设备端受限于大小、延迟和隐私约束下的商业意图检索：一个3 MiB的检索系统与类型化出口边界
summary_translated: 我们研究了完全在用户设备上运行的商业意图推断，在三个预先设定的约束条件下：下载负载低于3 MiB，Tier-0推理延迟在p95下不超过20毫秒，且不允许原始文本、内容嵌入或稳定标识符离开设备。在此约束下，我们构建了一个覆盖6,020个叶子节点的商业分类体系的检索路径：一个从韩语句子变换器中提炼出的静态嵌入表，量化至4比特，无需推理运行时。主要结果是这些约束对准确率的影响。在他人标注的真实韩语电商文本（22,900条AI-Hub购物评论）上，中等类别top-5在真实产品名称上的准确率为75.0%，而随机基线仅为18.4%；但这一结果存在明显差异：包含某个叶子名称作为子串的查询得分83.5%，不包含的则为45.2%。一个通用且大196.6倍的教师模型似乎揭示了这一差距的来源（无锚点时提升20.1个百分点，有锚点时仅提升0.1个百分点）。该零效果由两种效应抵消所致：在同一学生对比对上微调的教师模型达到0.8586，相比纯编码器学生模型在有锚点时提升10.6个百分点，无锚点时提升20.9个百分点。成本并非均匀分布，但任何地方都非免费；当缺乏锚点时，任务适应对教师模型毫无增益，因此受约束编码器在该区域所欠缺的是容量。高成本状态可通过排名器自身的得分差距在设备端检测到：降低最不自信的第五名得分可使其余得分提升至0.8296。第二个轴线——首次报告的制造商模型代码——在源类别固定效应下未能持续有效（-4.0个百分点，p=0.51）；而锚点则显著有效（+13.0个百分点）。总负载为2,942,652字节，所有三个库链接均经过测量。Tier-0 p95分别为4.431毫秒和3.670毫秒（两台iPhone A14、A16）以及5.080毫秒（预算安卓平板 Snapdragon 695），均慢于同代码下的三台服务器CPU。分类体系监督主要基于合成韩语文本。

summary: Neural audio codecs enable low-bitrate speech compression and tokenization, yet their robustness on accented and multilingual speech remains under-evaluated. We benchmark seven open-source neural codecs (DAC, EnCodec, FocalCodec, LanguageCodec, SemantiCodec, UniCodec, WavTokenizer) on three African speech datasets afrinames, afrispeech dialog, afrispeech multilingual, reporting signal-level quality (NISQA, UTMOS, ViSQOL, STOI, F0-RMSE) alongside two downstream tasks: automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speaker verification (ASV). Our analysis yields four findings. First, signal metrics differ sharply in downstream validity: reference-based structural/intelligibility measures (ViSQOL, STOI) and prosodic error (F0-RMSE) track ASR and ASV degradation far more reliably than neural mean-opinion-score predictors (NISQA, UTMOS). Second, intelligibility and speaker-identity preservation diverge sharply across architectures, and the apparent identity ranking itself depends on the ASV backend. Third, degradation is strongly domain-dependent and largest for conversational dialog. Fourth, the resulting degradation is partly recoverable: parameter-efficient \emph{codec} adaptation (LoRA, $\sim$1--3\% of parameters) on roughly 35 hours of African speech reduces the compression-induced word-error-rate gap, recovering recognition toward the uncompressed baseline (developed in companion work). These results motivate task-aware, domain-representative, and adaptation-aware evaluation of speech codecs as a prerequisite for inclusive deployment.
title: How Robust Are Neural Audio Codecs for African Speech? A Multi-Task Benchmark and the Limits of Perceptual Quality
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Technology
title_translated: 神经音频编解码器对非洲语音的鲁棒性如何？一个多任务基准测试及其感知质量的局限性
summary_translated: 神经音频编解码器实现了低比特率语音压缩与分词，但其在带有口音和多语言语音上的鲁棒性仍缺乏充分评估。我们在三个非洲语音数据集（afrinames、afrispeech dialog、afrispeech multilingual）上对七种开源神经编解码器（DAC、EnCodec、FocalCodec、LanguageCodec、SemantiCodec、UniCodec、WavTokenizer）进行了基准测试，报告了信号级质量指标（NISQA、UTMOS、ViSQOL、STOI、F0-RMSE）以及两个下游任务：自动语音识别（ASR）和说话人验证（ASV）。分析得出四个发现：第一，信号度量在下游有效性上差异显著：基于参考的结构/可理解性度量（ViSQOL、STOI）和韵律误差（F0-RMSE）比神经平均意见分数预测器（NISQA、UTMOS）更可靠地反映ASR和ASV退化情况；第二，可理解性和说话人身份保留能力在不同架构间差异显著，且看似的身份排序本身依赖于ASV后端；第三，退化强烈依赖于领域，对话类任务退化最大；第四，这种退化部分可恢复：在约35小时非洲语音上进行参数高效的编解码器适应（LoRA，约1–3%参数）可减少压缩引起的词错误率差距，使识别性能接近未压缩基线（在配套工作中开发）。这些结果强调了在部署前必须进行任务感知、领域代表性及适应感知的语音编解码器评估，以实现包容性应用。

summary: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.
title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
title_translated: 规避攻击：对抗噪声如何绕过机器学习分类器
summary_translated: 本文呈现了一项可复现的、教育性质的图像分类与文本分类中的规避攻击研究。一个在MNIST上训练的小型卷积网络达到了98.63%的干净测试准确率，并在两种白盒攻击下进行了评估。在FGSM攻击下，ε=0.15时准确率降至60.20%，ε=0.30时降至1.72%；在PGD攻击下分别降至32.47%和0.41%，而位深缩减防御仅部分恢复损失。在第二项实验中，经SMS垃圾短信数据集微调的DistilBERT达到98.75%准确率和94.96% F1分数，但预定义的扰动序列（字符替换、空格噪声、良性后缀）在大多数示例中仅引起适度的概率偏移，未导致从垃圾邮件到正常邮件的翻转。对抗脆弱性具有强烈的模态依赖性：MNIST实验是清晰的规避攻击演示，而文本实验则是受控的鲁棒性评估。鲁棒性必须通过实证测试而非仅从干净准确率推断。

summary: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.
title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
title_translated: DramaAgent：代理式叙事视频生成
summary_translated: 近期的扩散模型和自回归模型显著提升了文本到视频的生成能力，但生成具有连贯角色和对齐音频的长篇故事视频仍具挑战性。现有方法常面临叙事漂移、角色身份不稳定、跨场景连续性弱以及长时间序列中的音视频错配等问题。我们提出DramaAgent，一种分层、代理式且模型无关的长篇文本到音视频生成框架。不同于改进底层视频骨干模型，DramaAgent引入上层控制层，将生成过程分解为故事规划、持久角色条件化、逐场景合成以及反思引导的目标修复。该框架在场景间维护可重用的故事与角色状态，诊断如身份漂移、场景语义缺失、时间不连续性和跨模态错配等失败，并以阶段特定方式修复问题片段。在多个视频生成骨干模型上的实验表明，DramaAgent在长时程连贯性、角色一致性、叙事保真度和场景级音视频一致性方面优于直接生成和强基线方法。结果表明，分层代理控制是可控长篇音视频生成的一个可行方向。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent。

summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.
title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: this https URL (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
title_translated: 科学智能体：在科学任务上评估专业领域系统提示
summary_translated: 详细的领域特定系统提示虽提高了每响应的token使用量和估算成本，但并未带来一致的准确率提升。我们通过OpenRouter在Pi代理环境中，使用Gemini 3.8 Flash评估了Scientific Agents——一个包含503个领域特定AGENTS.md配置文件的开源语料库。我们将匹配的配置文件与四种对照组进行比较：最小基线（“你是一个乐于助人的助手”）、配置文件开头的角色句、通用科学严谨性指南，以及来自无关领域的配置文件。在九个基于文本的科学基准测试（4,531个采样问题，100个匹配配置文件）中，4,488项在API错误重试后完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则评分。平均配置文件-基线准确率差值为-0.6个百分点（95%置信区间[-1.5, +0.2]，固定任务范围内），无任何基准显示统计学上明显的改进。匹配配置文件产生的输出token数量为基线的1.5-2.3倍，每次成功调用的成本为2.2-4.5倍。在60个使用工具的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上（基线与配置文件各运行三次），平均解决率分别为46.7%（配置文件）和56.7%（基线），相差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主要由配置文件下更频繁的token和时间限制停止导致。较长提示有一个意外的操作优势：在SuperGPQA上，频繁的提供方API中断使得短基线仅在54.0%的项目中获得首次正确答案，而配置文件则达到71.6%。通用和不匹配提示的可靠性相当，因此这一优势来自提示长度或格式，而非领域专长。对于所测试的模型和任务，默认加载完整领域配置文件并不能提高准确率，反而成本显著更高；是否通过选择性检索配置文件部分或开放式的科学任务会改变这一结论，仍有待验证。

summary: Instance-billed serverless platforms charge for CPU and memory over the lifetime of a warm instance, making idle inference state a direct serving cost. We present billing-aware neural text-to-speech (TTS) serving on serverless CPUs, optimizing CPU-seconds and GB-seconds rather than throughput or latency alone. Conventional runtimes are poorly suited to this setting: per-request parallelism causes CPU contention under concurrency, while warm instances retain gigabytes of billable inference and page-cache state.   We address these costs with request-sized concurrent inference, which bounds per-request CPU parallelism, and a reclaimable instance lifecycle, which releases inference state and page-cache memory after idle periods while retaining the server process and compile cache. On Kokoro-82M, our system achieves 2.71 audio-seconds per CPU-second versus 0.89 with ONNX Runtime defaults and reduces cost per audio-hour from $0.0631 with PyTorch to $0.0153, a 4.1x reduction. Idle billed memory falls from 8.7 GB to 1.33 GB, while restoration reaches first audio in 2.2 s versus 7.7 s for a PyTorch cold start. Under bursty traffic, lifecycle reclamation is essential for translating inference efficiency into lower serverless cost.
title: Pushing CPU Speech Synthesis to the Wall: Extreme Inference Tuning under Serverless Architecture and Billing
title_translated: 将CPU语音合成推向极限：在无服务器架构与计费模式下的极端推理优化
summary_translated: 按实例计费的无服务器平台根据冷启动实例的CPU和内存使用时长收费，导致空闲推理状态直接产生服务成本。我们提出一种面向无服务器CPU的计费感知神经文本到语音（TTS）服务，优化CPU秒数和GB秒数，而非仅关注吞吐量或延迟。传统运行时在此场景下表现不佳：每请求并行处理引发高并发下的CPU竞争，而热实例会持续占用数GB的可计费推理和页面缓存状态。我们通过请求级并发推理来限制每请求的CPU并行度，并采用可回收的实例生命周期机制，在空闲期释放推理状态和页面缓存内存，同时保留服务器进程和编译缓存。在Kokoro-82M模型上，我们的系统实现每CPU秒生成2.71秒音频，优于ONNX Runtime默认配置的0.89；每小时音频成本从PyTorch的$0.0631降至$0.0153，降低4.1倍。空闲计费内存从8.7GB降至1.33GB，恢复时间从PyTorch冷启动的7.7秒缩短至2.2秒。在突发流量下，生命周期回收对于将推理效率转化为更低的无服务器成本至关重要。

summary: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.
title: Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Data, code, and collector at this http URL (research/lotto-models)
title_translated: 向语言模型询问彩票号码：六选四十九输出中的集中现象
summary_translated: 我们评估了多种语言模型配置在请求从1到49中随机选取六个不同整数的任务上的表现。在使用四种英文提示变体进行1,200次尝试调用中，1,184次响应生成了有效彩票。实际数字频率的有效多样性范围为9.9至18.0，远低于对应样本规模下独立均匀六选四十九采样的模拟第五百分位阈值（46.6–46.7）。各系统生成了8至93个不同的无序票面，其最常见票面占有效响应的22.5%至68.0%。两个已归档的波兰彩票样本提供了真实彩票对比，小样本下有效多样性分别为41.1和41.4。这些结果表明，在测试部署设置下存在显著的集中现象。但未揭示其机制，也未验证其他提示、温度或工具配置下的性能表现。

summary: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.
title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
title_translated: 表征一种推理时PRM剪枝片段嫁接失效的配置：来自三个推理型大模型的证据
summary_translated: 并行思维链中的多样性崩溃促使人们设计基于自然逻辑的推理时干预机制：当过程奖励模型（PRM）剪枝某条思维链时，将其高PRM前缀提取并原样作为上下文示例嫁接到仍在解码的兄弟链中。我们隔离出这一机制——PRM剪枝片段嫁接（PPFG），并将其视为跨轨迹步骤级迁移的最低成本实现方式。我们在先前研究报道仅在额外补偿成分下才有效的工作点上测试该机制。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型上，结合Math-Shepherd对完整MATH500数据集（n=500，三个种子）的实验中，PPFG在停滞目标和随机目标两种变体下，在所有测量维度上均与独立并行思维链基线无统计差异。我们分析原因：对322次停滞规则注入事件的四类分类显示，仅有14%针对真正陷入困境的链；其余均落在已成功、接近完成或处于PRM平坦区的链上，这些状态无法通过救援嫁接改变。复合门控优化未能同时实现精准触发与足够密度，且随机对照组以2.4倍更高的触发率达到相同平衡性，说明该失效并非启发式特定。该发现可在三个基础大模型、六个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描中复现；双单侧检验分析将所有十二个Qwen/LLaMA单元的差异提升为正向等价性。事件级抽查显示注入链的剪枝速率是匹配步骤的2.75倍，但存活兄弟链反事实分析未发现群体层面的补偿效应。事后oracle分析表明，选择PPFG相对于独立解码的每问题增益上限仅为+0.13个百分点。我们贡献了一种用于建立推理时机制零假设的等价性检验模板，所有结论均限定于所测试的操作点。

summary: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.
title: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
title_translated: 在多实例强化学习系统中融合公平性与可解释性
summary_translated: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现需要既准确又足够透明以支持有意义干预的模型，而人口统计信息则引入不公平预测的风险。本研究探讨一种多目标框架，结合基于强化学习的多实例学习（RL-MIL）、对抗去偏和偏好条件超网络，用于识别高风险学生。MIL将每位学生表示为一组弱标签的交互记录，而强化学习代理选择有信息量的实例用于下游分类。评估了两种超网络变体，以确定用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与平等机会之间的权衡。底层RL-MIL基线表现出强分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式崩溃：改变偏好权重在预期的公平性-性能前沿上几乎无系统性移动。失败归因于目标主导、条件机制中梯度传播微弱以及动态生成参数间的相互作用。结果表明，公平性目标可融入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但偏好条件本身不足以保证可控的多目标行为。因此，稳健的公平强化学习多实例学习需显式引入梯度平衡、目标分离和稳定性分析机制。

summary: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency, memory, energy, and real-time factor were not measured. All evaluation speech and targets are synthetic, references are model-proposed, and the judge is uncalibrated. The evidence shows that a compact model can acquire a narrow audio-to-structure transformation from a few hundred provenance-linked synthetic examples; it does not establish clinical validity, real-speech transfer, or superiority to a clean cloud system.
title: High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model
comment: Submitted to On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table
title_translated: 用于紧凑日语语音模型参数高效适配的高价值合成监督
summary_translated: 私有领域语音数据难以收集和共享，而紧凑模型需要任务特定的监督信号。我们研究了一种可审计的合成管道，将日语护理交接内容直接映射为六字段结构化笔记。利用182个合成训练和开发片段，我们通过全微调和秩16 LoRA对一个14.7亿参数的音频模型进行适配。在39个片段、场景-种子不重叠的合成测试中，未经适配模型的模型判断事实召回得分为0.0500，全微调为0.8664，LoRA为0.8461。LoRA在描述性比率上达到全微调聚合性能的97.7%，项目遥测报告其可训练参数为1240万，约占主干模型的0.85%。两种适配方法均在相同基线基础上表现出显著提升；全微调与LoRA之间的差距跨越零点，且优化设置差异使等价性声明不可成立。这是一项参数高效的能力建立成果，而非设备性能结果：未测量延迟、内存、能耗和实时因子。所有评估语音和目标均为合成数据，参考由模型提出，评判者未经校准。证据表明，紧凑模型可从数百个来源可追溯的合成示例中获取狭窄的语音到结构转换能力；但并未证明临床有效性、真实语音迁移能力，或优于干净云系统的优越性。

summary: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.
title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
title_translated: 编码但断连：在补丁空模型下分解视觉-语言模型的失败
summary_translated: 在三种视觉-语言模型架构（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B）中，我们报告了关于中间层可解释性的普遍负面发现。在所有三种模型共用的POPE基准测试中，中间层在68%-91%的错误中编码了真实答案，但该信号对最终预测并非因果激活：残差流补丁实验在所有三种架构的层级别均未产生非平凡的预测翻转（0%），在其中两种架构的头级别也未产生（Qwen：12,600个头中无一成功）。唯一例外是InternVL3第20层第2个头，这是一个非词汇、自注意力的头，其影响局限于该特定头（p < 1e-4）。尽管存在这一空效应，错误仍可操作性地分为三种失败模式——感知失败、编码但断连、先验覆盖——在所有三种架构上均可学习且准确率超过60%，且模型的先验方向能预测哪种干预会引发特定类别响应。我们报告了在理想标签下的缓解效果，作为这些类别具有机制真实性的证据，而非可部署的方法。

summary: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.
title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
title_translated: 推理过程传递的信息是什么？角色专业化问答中的消息干预研究
summary_translated: 角色专业化问答流水线越来越多地将推理过程从推理器传递给验证器，但尚不清楚这种信息传递究竟带来了什么价值：更好的答案、更强的支持评估，还是新的失败面？我们引入了一种消息干预诊断方法，在固定证据和候选答案的前提下，仅改变推理器到验证器边界间传递的推理过程。在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA样本上，使用DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器进行实验，发现忠实的推理过程几乎不会提升答案准确性，而被破坏的推理过程则显著改变了支持判断。在盲验证提示下，无害的改写仅使支持度变化0–2.5%，而被破坏的推理过程使支持度变化10–22%；显式要求检查推理过程的提示将相同模式放大至34–55%。最终答案的变化较小（2–30%），且仅有2.9–35.3%的被破坏支持度变化与答案变化同时发生。人工审计揭示了其重要性：42个有效破坏案例中有16个属于‘过度信任破坏’，且在10个被审计的被破坏推理过程中，有9个被人类拒绝或标记为不清晰，而模型却接受了它们。跨模型和任务边界检查揭示了该通信通道在何时活跃、增强、失效或被融合进任务标签。推理过程共享应被视为一种验证性消息机制，而不仅仅是提高答案准确性的路径。

summary: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention
title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
title_translated: FourierQK：滤波器形状、可接受性与泄漏-覆盖定律
summary_translated: 频率坍缩注意力[Zeris, 2026e]通过在学习到的频率上用带通滤波内积替代标准点积注意力，实现了相对于标准点积注意力的巨大提升。一个自然的后续问题是：哪种滤波器形状表现最佳，以及原因何在？我们在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行了受控消融实验，测试了五个关于滤波器特性的假设——直流抑制、奈奎斯特抑制、带宽、中心频率和多尺度覆盖。主要发现包括：(1) 直流和奈奎斯特分量具有实际危害性（val ≈ 2.0，相当于相位随机化），证实振荡带通结构是本质性的，而不仅仅是任何低维频谱摘要；(2) 最优单尺度带宽为σ ≈ 2个区间，中心位于段落尺度（约70个词元），相比BASE-DOT带来+1.15纳特的清晰增益；(3) 可接受滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽DOG m=2）在相同尺度下优于非可接受高斯滤波器，并提供部分对双边FFT泄漏的保护；(4) 双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增长——窄带滤波器（gap > +4）干净，宽带滤波器（gap < +2）存在泄漏；(5) 在字符尺度上的因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128抽头覆盖T=256上下文的50%），这促使我们在配套论文[MorletQK, Zeris, 2026f]中开展词级实验。综合(1)-(5)发现表明，FourierQK在双向注意力场景（如BERT风格的编码器）中表现优异，前提是训练和推理时均可获得完整序列上下文；而自回归生成则需要因果频谱变体如MorletQK（如GPT风格的解码器）。代码已公开：https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

summary: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.
title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: 基于严重程度基础知识图谱与检索增强生成的轨迹感知临床风险预测
summary_translated: 尽管电子健康记录（EHR）提供了丰富的临床数据，但如何有效利用异构外部知识来增强患者记录以预测其临床风险仍是重大挑战。现有方法因数据稀疏性和对非结构化临床笔记的利用不足，难以捕捉疾病严重程度、治疗反应及复杂的临床进展。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TRACER（一种轨迹感知且临床基础的预测框架），该框架（1）构建了一个从医学文献中融入严重程度信息的医学知识图谱，（2）从知识图谱中检索与患者病情进展相关的、带有严重程度加权的路径，（3）从非结构化临床笔记中提取相关临床事件，（4）通过相似同行病例增强患者上下文。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，TRACER相较于现有最先进基线取得了显著提升，死亡预测任务的宏F1分数最高提升28.5%，再入院预测任务提升19.7%。
